question: In a certain code language, EDUCATION is written as 92. How will KNOWLEDGE be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**The number written in the coded words is the sum of the positional values of the letters in the word.**

In EDUCATION → 92 .​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/285e9d91007939ec1a921ff01f78ab1d66a97ae2c762d991b5c3ef240c336fda.png] 

Sum of all positional values = 5 + 4 + 21 + 3 + 1 + 20 + 9 +15 + 14 = 92

Similarly,

In KNOWLEDGE → ​?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14a060114787a962b9f5c377f3cf56ba2b424f9f617e4fa62c3510126f63722a.png] 

Sum of all positional values = 11 + 14 + 15 + 23 + 12 + 5 + 4 + 7 + 5 = **96**

Hence, Option 4) is the correct answer.
